title: Surreal Egg Corridor
description: A surreal painting depicts an endless hallway of repeating doorways and framed floral panels receding into the distance. In the foreground, a giant cracked egg structure spills long white strands and roots onto a reflective black floor, surrounded by pink smiley-face flowers on green vines.
